headline: 愛丁堡藝穗節看點
context: 愛丁堡藝穗節（Edinburgh Fringe）今年有 3,649 場演出。舞蹈與馬戲類節目相當有企圖心，鋼管舞雙人組唐娜·卡諾（Donna Carnow）與吉娜·奧姆（Gina Alm）在作品《Dusk/Night/Dawn》裡，展現出驚人的體能與技巧。另一篇報導則走訪了藝穗節裡更大膽前衛的演出，觀察這個藝術節「激進實驗」的精神是否還在。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: With brute strength and beauty, party tricks and personal revelations, this year’s dance and circus programme has ambition and a spirit of togetherness If you want to be wowed by technical prowess, I recommend taking a trip to see a couple of New York pole dancers, Donna Carnow and Gina Alm, in their Edinburgh fringe show Dusk/Night/Dawn. The pair are wildly impressive performers with just one piece of apparatus, a hanging pole suspended above the stage, on which they climb and spin and balance seemingly on thin air and origami their limbs into impossible shapes, swimming and spiralling through the shadows in mesmerising fashion. What they demonstrate is absolute mastery of their art, Carnow especially – a former dancer and US Pole Art champion. The movement is utterly fluid, despite the brute strength required; the physics of it is so finely tuned but you’re unaware because you’re lost in the flow. That’s what a great performer does, and Dusk/Night/Dawn is in part about performance. At one point their two bodies are writhing under flashing red light, smeared with black paint, and then suddenly the lights come up and it’s like waking up, they’re wiping themselves down, the act’s over. There are all sorts of slippery questions about the dissolving line between person and performer, the nature of fantasy, the pleasure of discovering the power of your own body, and there’s also just the awesome talent. sources.title: Shapes and ladders: Edinburgh fringe’s dance shows reach for the sky

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: There are 3,649 shows at the fringe this year, but how many embody its spirit of radical experimentation? I took a journey through foam, lube and gore to find out ... Somewhere in Edinburgh, a man is drinking his own urine . Elsewhere, the story of a religious sect that commands its followers to use “butt plugs” plays out as a musical. In yet another room, a comedian sings the same song over and over for an hour . It is shows like these that have sustained the welcomingly weird and ungovernable lore of the Edinburgh festival fringe. In recent years, though, the annual jamboree has been accused of becoming an increasingly commercially savvy entity. The radical experimentalism might just be intact, but does this now sit at the fringes of the fringe, rather than its centre? Continue reading...

愛丁堡藝穗節（Edinburgh Fringe）今年有 3,649 場演出。舞蹈與馬戲類節目相當有企圖心，鋼管舞雙人組唐娜·卡諾（Donna Carnow）與吉娜·奧姆（Gina Alm）在作品《Dusk/Night/Dawn》裡，展現出驚人的體能與技巧。另一篇報導則走訪了藝穗節裡更大膽前衛的演出，觀察這個藝術節一路以來「激進實驗」的精神，是否還在。

voice_text: 愛丁堡藝穗節，今年有 3,649 場演出。舞蹈跟馬戲類的節目特別有企圖心，有一組鋼管舞雙人組合，靠一根懸吊的鋼管，展現出驚人的體能跟技巧。另外也有人專門走訪那些更大膽前衛的演出，想看看這個藝術節一路以來的「激進實驗」精神，是不是還在。
